name: Smart Office Building
label: Intelligent workspace · 4 floors
summary: Four-floor intelligent workplace with rooftop plant, collaboration zones, lobby and EV parking.

cases.title: Workplace utilisation
cases.hypothesis: Turn occupancy and booking signals into an evidence-led consolidation and workplace redesign decision.
cases.baseline: Actual weekly utilisation by zone and day
cases.value: Lower unused estate costs; protect workplace experience
cases.partner: Workplace analytics assessment + integration + managed occupancy insights
cases.cisco: Cisco wireless + Cisco Spaces + Webex / ecosystem integration
cases.next: Validate privacy-safe aggregated occupancy against booking and lease economics.

cases.title: Energy / carbon performance
cases.hypothesis: Identify after-hours conditioning and opportunities for occupancy-informed HVAC scheduling without compromising comfort.
cases.cisco: Industrial networking + secure IoT visibility + specialist BMS / analytics partner
cases.next: Map metering zones to BMS operating schedules and confirm control authority.

cases.title: Predictive equipment health
cases.hypothesis: Join asset telemetry and service work orders to improve reliability and prioritise planned maintenance.
cases.baseline: Downtime hours, reactive work and failure frequency
cases.value: Avoided incidents and reduced reactive maintenance
cases.partner: Asset services, field maintenance, assurance contracts
cases.cisco: Resilient OT connectivity, cyber segmentation, observability + FM ISV
cases.next: Identify five failure modes and test fault-to-work-order data lineage.

cases.title: Connected safety & cyber risk
cases.hypothesis: Reduce blind spots in connected building operations across access, cameras and OT networks.
cases.baseline: Detection-to-response times and uncovered OT assets
cases.value: Lower operational exposure and incident impact
cases.confidence: Risk reduction proxy, not guaranteed savings
cases.partner: OT discovery + security design + 24×7 managed detection
cases.cisco: Cyber controls, segmentation and cross-domain observability
cases.next: Complete an approved IT/OT asset discovery and threat workshop.

cases.title: Estate economics & lease options
cases.hypothesis: Connect utilisation and energy performance to lease events and total occupancy cost.
signals: Rent, service charges and lease break dates
cases.baseline: Cost per useful occupied sqm / seat
cases.value: Working capital and cost savings through better portfolio decisions
cases.confidence: Portfolio scenario · not additive to space case
cases.partner: Value baseline pack, finance model, programme integration
cases.cisco: Cisco-enabled contextual telemetry with commercial data partners
cases.next: Agree CFO business-case boundaries and lease decision dates.

cases.title: Indoor experience & wellbeing
cases.hypothesis: Correlate ventilation, temperature and service tickets with feedback and utilisation.
cases.value: Better experience and fewer productivity barriers
cases.confidence: Benefits hard to monetise; exclude unvalidated productivity
cases.cisco: Wireless sensing context + Webex workplace + specialist sensors
cases.next: Agree measurement protocol and privacy guardrails.

cases.title: Unified building data fabric
cases.hypothesis: Create secure governed interoperability across isolated IT, OT and enterprise sources.
cases.baseline: Integration coverage, stale signals and cost to integrate
cases.value: Lower integration friction, faster cross-domain use cases
cases.confidence: Enabler value, avoid double counting downstream
cases.partner: Architecture + integration + managed data quality SLAs
cases.cisco: Networking, IoT, security, observability, ecosystem data platforms
cases.next: Design minimum viable signal contract and access governance.

story: Show how a Value Twin aligns signals, decision-makers, technical capabilities and financial outcomes before specifying a full digital twin.
